完成。结果摘要：

**all_vs_size_matched** (diff = -0.032, Cohen's d = -86.0):
| Margin | Equivalent? |
|--------|------------|
| 1% (0.023) | NO (p=1.00) |
| 2% (0.047) | YES (p<0.001) |
| 3% (0.070) | YES (p<0.001) |
| 5% (0.117) | YES (p<0.001) |

**all_vs_depth01** (diff = -0.052, Cohen's d = -119.7):
| Margin | Equivalent? |
|--------|------------|
| 1% (0.023) | NO (p=1.00) |
| 2% (0.047) | NO (p=1.00) |
| 3% (0.070) | YES (p<0.001) |
| 5% (0.117) | YES (p<0.001) |

size_matched 在 2% margin 即达等价；depth01 需要 3% margin。脚本写入 `tost_multi_margin.py`，结果写入 `results/tost_multi_margin.json`。
